# Sip N Snack Co. — Full AI and Business Reference

Sip N Snack Co. is a Toronto-based B2B edible beverage cup supplier serving café, chai, hotel, catering, wholesale and distribution inquiries across the GTA, Ontario, Canada and the USA.

## What is an edible cup?
An edible cup is drinkware intended to be eaten after a beverage. Buyers should evaluate exact product specifications, ingredients, allergens, storage, serving conditions and handling before using it in their businesses.

## Business purchasing process
1. Request product information and sample availability.
2. Evaluate samples with your intended beverage and service workflow.
3. Request a quote stating your estimated quantity, location and delivery date.
4. Confirm the actual product, delivery arrangements, price and payment terms before ordering.

## Geographic and production information
Sip N Snack Co. serves business inquiries starting in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area, then Ontario and Canada, and also welcomes USA inquiries. Cups are produced in India. Product imagery is illustrative and does not certify flavour, ingredients, packaging or availability.
